verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page claims 'Full accounts payable' as a service offering, but there is no evidence describing bill capture, approval routing, or payment scheduling as a cohesive in-product workflow — it reads as an outsourced bookkeeping service rather than a self-serve AP tool. missing for 10: details on bill capture/OCR, approval workflow routing, payment scheduling mechanics, and any user/independent corroboration of the AP workflow itself.
